test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: What will be the compound interest on Rs. 30,000 at 10% per annum for 1(1)/(2) years, when interest is compounded half-yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 30,000

Rate of interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time (T) = 1(1/2) years = 1.5 years

**Formula Used:**

When interest is compounded half-yearly, the rate and time are adjusted as follows:

Rate for half-year = R/2

Time in half-years = T × 2

Compound Interest (CI) = P × (1 + R/200)ⁿ - P&l
